## Advantages by affirmative

Under each aff, the advantages read in the affirmative rounds assigned to it (by the round's plan text or the team's other rounds), ranked by the teams reading them; the 5 the most teams read are shown. A round assigned to a mechanism counts under the mechanism and once under its aff. An advantage read in a round assigned to another aff is never counted under this one, and nothing is taken from an advantage's name.

### Single payer (`single-payer-aff`)

6 assigned rounds by 5 teams; 4 of the teams read an advantage.

| Advantage | Teams |
|---|---|
| Costs advantage (`costs-advantage`) | 3 |
| Coverage advantage (`coverage-advantage`) | 3 |
| Budgets advantage (`budgets-advantage`) | 2 |
| Disease advantage (`disease-advantage`) | 2 |
| Inequality advantage (`inequality-advantage`) | 1 |

And 2 more advantages, read by 1 team.

#### Global budgets (`global-budgets-aff`), a mechanism of Single payer

2 assigned rounds by 2 teams; 2 of the teams read an advantage.

| Advantage | Teams |
|---|---|
| Budgets advantage (`budgets-advantage`) | 2 |
| Costs advantage (`costs-advantage`) | 2 |

### Public option (`public-option-aff`)

1 assigned round by 1 team; 1 of the teams read an advantage.

| Advantage | Teams |
|---|---|
| Innovation advantage (`innovation-advantage`) | 1 |
| Pandemics advantage (`pandemics-advantage`) | 1 |

Assigned rounds with no advantage read: Nanomedicine coverage (`nanomedicine-aff`), a mechanism of Single payer, 1 round; Vouchers (`voucher-aff`), 1 round.

4 advantage reads in 3 affirmative rounds, by 2 teams, have no assigned aff.
A placed card identifies the aff of 1 of those rounds, and their advantages are not counted under it.
